title: Tiger Census And Lion Census
definition: Systematic, periodic scientific estimation of population, distribution, and habitat status of Panthera tigris (Tiger) and Panthera leo persica (Asiatic Lion) in India, conducted to inform conservation policy and wildlife management.
importanceInUpsc: High-frequency topic in Environment & Ecology (Prelims) and Biodiversity/Conservation (Mains). Focuses on institutional mechanisms (NTCA, WII), methodology (M-STrIPES), and species-specific conservation status.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Tiger Census And Lion Census.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
